title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Share Borne by the Part of the Term Still to Run
content:
## Contract administration table

The share the part of the term still to run bears, on a reinstatement of a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record, follows what is left of the term at the reinstatement day. The reading is the whole months of the term remaining at that day.

| Whole months of the term remaining at the reinstatement day | Share borne |
|---|---|
| no whole month remains | the residual term share, 30 percent |
| between one and six whole months remain | the part term share, 60 percent |
| more than six whole months remain | the whole of it, that is 1.0 |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- 0 whole months remaining: the residual term share, 30 percent.
- Exactly 1 whole month remaining: between one and six, so the part term share, 60 percent.
- Exactly 6 whole months remaining: still between one and six, so 60 percent.
- 7 whole months remaining: more than six, so the whole of the fee taken, 1.0 of it.

### Illustration (hypothetical figures)

A reinstatement fee taken of 300.00 USD bears 90.00 USD where no whole month of the term remains, 180.00 USD where between one and six whole months remain, and 300.00 USD where more than six whole months remain.
